images.caption: Figure 1:(a) CARD clusters user histories and trains group-specific PEFT modules as warm-start priors. (b) It then constructs input-aligned implicit preference pairs using the user’s answer and the corresponding group-generated answer. (c) Preference data pairs are used to learn a dense user vector for user-level personalization on the frozen LLM. (d) During inference, CARD starts from group-conditioned logits as a shared prior and then refines them with a user-specific modification for personalized decoding.

Figure 3:A case study for LaMP-7. The gray background highlights the longest contiguous span shared with the reference/user’s answer, while the yellow background highlights content overlapping with the user history.
